fields: [pic=2]Hello dear, we were just talking about you!
[pic=1]Of course! We were talking about how things have gotten a whole lot naughtier since you’ve been here.
[pic=2]Indeed! Since telling you about my little story, I decided to get some more girl time with Scarlett.
[pic=1]All this talk makes me wanna go down on your cute bird rump, right here, right now.
[pic=9]Scarlett! Gosh, not in front of Rascal!
[pic=2]Hah! Let ‘em watch! Better yet, let him join!
[pic=2]Oh! I just thought of a good name for your… “side business.”
[pic=7]Instead of Penny Plume’s Ride and Zoom…
[pic=1]Y’know, we were also talking a bit about some stuff Penny wants to experiment with…
[pic=2]Come on darling, you can hide me under those feathers, and I can do my work right here~ No one will suspect a thing!
[pic=1]That is… If you can contain yourself…
[pic=7]Scarlett, do I need to drop you in the river AGAIN?
[pic=2]But I do hope you can explore that side of you if it’s something you want, though!
[pic=7]And a complete mockery of my business! How dare you!
[pic=11]Penny Plume’s Ride and Spoon? Penny Plume’s Ride and Poon?
[pic=7]Hehe, so you know how our wonderful Penny here is quite the service girl, right? Married to her work and being so useful…
[pic=1]She was just telling me how exciting it would be to offer a different service!
[pic=6]Aw, what, should I really not continue?
[pic=3]Gosh, you’ll be the death of me, girl.

You don’t have to share
if you don’t want to.
[pic=3]Well, I had a dream once, and for some reason I can’t get it out of my head…
[pic=9]I was tied up at my perch… Blind folded… gagged… My rear completely exposed…
[pic=9]One by one, critters would have a go, leaving me a quivering mess!
[pic=3]Baw I dunno… it probably sounds stupid…
[pic=1]Plus, I think it’s super cute since you’re such a service bird already! You truly just want to make your customers happy!
[pic=2]Honey, I’m all for it, I say we make it happen!
